'''''Interrogator''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="CL" /> of the [[Galactic Empire]] that participated in the [[Battle of Endor]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Inalis]],<ref name="Rise" /> as well as the [[Battle of Jakku]], the final battle of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the fledgling [[New Republic]]. During the battle, ''Interrogator'' deployed ''[[Hellhound Two]]'',<ref name="CL" /> an [[All Terrain Armored Transport]] of the [[Hellhound attack force]] in a last ditched defense of an [[Imperial research base]].<ref name="On the Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref> The walker was abandoned after the Empire's defeat on [[Jakku]], and eventually became the home of the [[scavenger]], [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. In the battle, the [[Star Destroyer]] crashed onto the surface of Jakku, where the wreck of the ship remained for decades. Rey salvaged parts from the ''Interrogator's'' interior during her time on Jakku, and presented her findings to [[Unkar Plutt]].<ref name="CL" />
